title: KDA Candidate Record
description: One line of <task-workspace>/runs/candidates.jsonl. Every attempt is recorded, including rejected and regressed ones, so that a later reader can answer 'why is this version the best one?'.

parent.description: Identifier of the candidate this one was derived from. Null when it derives directly from the baseline.

hypothesis.description: The single coherent change this candidate tests.

latency_us.description: Measured value of the target metric for this candidate.

baseline_us.description: Measured baseline value the candidate is compared against.

profile_evidence.description: Path under profile/ or an artifact identifier that justifies this change. Required before a final promotion that relies on a bottleneck claim.

generalization_evidence.description: Path or artifact identifier for guard-shape or generalization evidence when required.

reason.description: Why it was rejected or revised. Required when decision is not "keep".

rollback.description: Rollback result after this candidate was rejected or revised.
